mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for a backyard sauna in Oakville?

acceptedAnswer.text: An accessory building over 10 m² typically needs a building permit, zoning setbacks apply, and the electrical connection needs an ESA permit. Heritage districts and lots near regulated ravines can need extra review. We check before you order.

mainEntity.name: My lot backs onto a ravine. Can I still have a sauna?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes. Lots near watercourses like Sixteen Mile Creek may be regulated by Conservation Halton, so we place the sauna away from the slope and suggest confirming with them early.

mainEntity.name: Can the sauna match my home's design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose clear or knotty cedar, glass options, lighting and heater style. We'll help you match your home and landscaping.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Oakville?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Oakville. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
